heading: Our suite of Google Ads Services
text2: Search, display, shopping or video, we manage the whole Google Ads account for you.

items.title: Search Campaigns
items.text: Text ads shown to people actively searching for your products and services.

items.title: Display & Remarketing
items.text: Banner ads across millions of sites that keep your brand in front of past visitors.

items.title: Shopping Campaigns
items.text: Product listings with photos and prices to bring ready-to-buy shoppers to your store.

items.title: Keyword Research
items.text: In-depth research that finds high-intent, affordable keywords and filters out wasted clicks.

items.title: Landing Page Optimization
items.text: Better pages, clearer offers and stronger calls to action to raise your conversion rate.

items.title: Conversion Tracking & Reports
items.text: Accurate tracking of calls, forms and sales with clear reports on spend and return.
